summary.text: David Steffen is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 4, who took office on January 5, 2015, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Alexia Unertl.

paragraphs.text: David Steffen's professional experience includes working as director of operations for Taxpayers Network, Inc., director of external affairs for AT&T and legislative coordinator for American Medical Security.
He was an aide to State Representative Mark Green in the 1990s and served on the Howard Village Board and the Brown County Board of Supervisors for eight years.
Steffen was elected to the Assembly in November 2014 and has won District 4 general elections in 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024.
For 2025-2026 he chairs the Energy and Utilities Committee and also sits on the Criminal Justice and Public Safety, Government Accountability and Oversight, and Insurance committees.
